prov:Entity.dcterms:title: ValidationReport
prov:Entity.dcterms:description: Validation Report (VR) result described in SHACL Vocabulary created by the Validation Engine.

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: Gen-VR
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the generic action of generating a validation Report (VR) described with SHACL Validation Report Vocabulary.

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: IGM-EQ
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the action of creating the offline Equipment (EQ) definition for Individual Grid Model (IGM).

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: IGM-EQ-VF
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the action of verifying (VF) of the offline Equipment (EQ) definition for Individual Grid Model (IGM).

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: IGM-ER
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the action of creating the offline Equipment Reliability (ER) definition for Individual Grid Model (IGM).

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: IGM-ER-VF
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the action of verifying (VF) the offline Equipment Reliability (ER) definition for Individual Grid Model (IGM).

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: IGM-RA
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the action of creating the offline Remedial Action (RA) definition for Individual Grid Model (IGM).

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: IGM-RA-VF
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the action of verifying (VF) the offline Remedial Action (RA) definition for Individual Grid Model (IGM).

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: IGM-RAS
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the action of proposed Remedial Action Schedule (RAS) on the definition offline Remedial Action (RA) for Individual Grid Model (IGM).

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: IGM-RAS-VF
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the action of verifying (VF) the proposed Remedial Action Schedule (RAS) for Individual Grid Model (IGM)..

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: IGM-RASR
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the action of response to proposed Remedial Action Schedule (RAS) for Individual Grid Model (IGM).

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: IGM-RASR-VF
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the action of verifying (VF) the response to proposed Remedial Action Schedule (RAS) for Individual Grid Model (IGM).

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: CGM-IAM
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the action of calculating and generating the Impact Assessment Matrix (IAM) of the Remedial Action (RA) for Common Grid Model (CGM).

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: CGM-IAM-VF
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the action of verifying (VF) Impact Assessment Matrix (IAM) of the Remedial Action (RA) for Common Grid Model (CGM).

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: IGM-FAP
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the action of proposed Remedial Action Schedule (RAS) as part of Fast Activation Process (FAP) for Individual Grid Model (IGM).

prov:Activity.dcterms:title: IGM-FAP-VF
prov:Activity.dcterms:description: This is the action of verifying (VF) proposed Remedial Action Schedule (RAS) as part of Fast Activation Process (FAP).
